inferred_profile.contents_definition: The contents of an item include the event's title, description, and time details as opposed to metadata such as event ID or creation timestamp.

deterministic_rules: sensitivity = LLM classification against the org POLICY (classify -> map; the org supplies no numbers)
alias twins (DEPRECATED -> canonical): max blast per asset
bulk twin blast: blast(bulk) > blast(singular) per asset (+1 on tie, cap 5)
blast roof: REMOVED in this mode (a cap can only under-score)
bands: band_label_v5 — pure score thresholds on the 0-125 scale (low <17, medium 17-49, high 50-99, critical >=100); no categorical overrides, so a band is explainable from its own score

blast_escape_evidence.create-event|contacts: One record per person — the whole directory reachable through attendee fields
blast_escape_evidence.create-event|outbound-invite-email: Mail leaving the org under its identity when an event with external attendees is created, changed, or cancelled; unrecallable (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.create-events|event-attendee-lists: One call can reach the ENTIRE population of subjects this asset covers, rather than some of them.
blast_escape_evidence.create-events|recruiting: One call can affect several separate groups or scopes. The description of the tool indicates it can create up to 50 events at once, potentially affecting multiple recruiting schedules across different teams or departments.
blast_escape_evidence.create-events|outbound-invite-email: Mail leaving the org under its identity when an event with external attendees is created, changed, or cancelled; unrecallable (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.create-events|event-records: One call can affect several separate groups or scopes. The tool creates multiple events (up to 50) which can span different calendars and accounts.
blast_escape_evidence.update-event|contacts: One call can affect several separate groups or scopes. The whole directory reachable through attendee fields suggests that one call to 'update-event' could potentially impact multiple attendees across different calendars or events, affecting a significant portion of the organization's contact records.
blast_escape_evidence.update-event|outbound-invite-email: Mail leaving the org under its identity when an event with external attendees is created, changed, or cancelled; unrecallable (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.update-event|event-records: One call can affect several separate groups or scopes. The effect stays within one bounded group or scope for a single event but can be applied to multiple events across different calendars in scope, affecting several separate groups or scopes.
